content: Gemini structured output (responseMimeType application/json + responseSchema) can still fail: when output exceeds max_output_tokens, response.text/parsed return None and JSON is truncated/unparseable; Flash can enter token-repetition loops inside JSON literals running to MAX_TOKENS (~30% of some workloads). Must still guard JSON.parse, check finishReason==MAX_TOKENS, and validate parsed object (e.g. Zod) even with schema set.
